nodes.description: assetAddress: NFT asset contract (ERC721/ERC1155) that the vault holds.
vaultFactory: INFTXVaultFactory used for fees, eligibility and locking.
vaultId: identifier of this vault within the factory.
manager: privileged account that may configure vault options.
holdings: EnumerableSet of token ids currently owned by the vault.
quantity1155: per-token-id balances for ERC1155 assets.
eligibilityStorage: optional eligibility module gating deposits.
isPaused: factory mapping of lock ids to paused state used by onlyOwnerIfPaused.
excludedFromFees: factory mapping of addresses exempt from mint/redeem/swap fees.
_vaultFees: per-vault fee struct plus global factory fee constants.
feeDistributor: contract receiving and distributing collected fees.
vaults: array of deployed vault proxy addresses.
_childImplementation: beacon implementation address cloned by BeaconProxy.
_owner: owner account used by onlyOwner / onlyPrivileged checks.
__NFTXVault_init: initializes ownership, ERC20 metadata, asset, factory, vaultId and features.
setVaultMetadata: privileged rename of the vault token.
setVaultFeatures: privileged toggling of mint/redeem/swap enable flags.
assignDefaultFeatures: hardcoded-address guarded backdoor that copies redeem flags to swap flags.
setManager: privileged assignment of the vault manager.
mintTo: nonReentrant mint entry point that pulls NFTs and mints vault shares.
redeemTo: nonReentrant burn plus NFT withdrawal path (callable directly by anyone).
swapTo: nonReentrant NFT swap path withdrawing then receiving tokens.
flashLoan: mints and burns tokens around an external onFlashLoan callback.
receiveNFTs: validates eligibility and pulls ERC721/ERC1155 assets into the vault.
withdrawNFTsTo: releases held NFTs (random or specific) to a recipient.
_chargeAndDistributeFees: transfers fees to the distributor and triggers distribution.
transferERC721: builds calldata and performs a low-level call to send an ERC721 out.
transferFromERC721: builds calldata and low-level calls an ERC721 to pull a token in.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault: pseudo-random selection using blockhash/coinbase/difficulty/timestamp.
onlyPrivileged: access control helper checking manager or owner.
onlyOwnerIfPaused: checks factory lock state against owner for a lockId.
createVault: factory entry point deploying a beacon proxy vault and registering it.
setVaultFees: factory setter callable by owner or by the vault itself.
setFactoryFees: onlyOwner setter of global default fees.
disableVaultFees: factory deleter callable by owner or the vault.
setFeeDistributor: onlyOwner update of the fee distributor address.
setFeeExclusion: onlyOwner toggling of the fee-exclusion mapping.
deployVault: deploys a BeaconProxy clone and initializes/manages/transfers ownership.
setZapContract: onlyOwner update of the zap contract address.
setEligibilityManager: onlyOwner update of the eligibility manager address.
mint: external wrapper delegating to mintTo with msg.sender as recipient.
redeem: external wrapper delegating to redeemTo with msg.sender as recipient.
swap: external wrapper delegating to swapTo with msg.sender as recipient.
deployEligibilityStorage: privileged deployment and wiring of the eligibility module.
setFees: privileged vault call forwarding fees to the factory.
vaultFees: view aggregating the five fee values from the factory.
Proxy._delegate: raw delegatecall forwarding calldata to the implementation.
BeaconProxy._setBeacon: stores the beacon and delegatecalls it with init data.
BeaconProxy._implementation: reads the beacon address and returns its child implementation.
PausableUpgradeable.pause: guardian-only locking of a lockId.
setIsGuardian: onlyOwner granting of pause rights.
upgradeChildTo: onlyOwner beacon upgrade entry point.
_setChildImplementation: validates and stores the new beacon implementation.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used in many transfers and checks.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value used in randomness derivation.
Low-level address(assetAddr).call(data) sending an NFT out of the vault.
Low-level address(assetAddr).call(data) pulling an NFT into the vault.
delegatecall in Proxy._delegate executing arbitrary implementation code in proxy storage.
Address.functionDelegateCall used to run beacon init data.
External receiver.onFlashLoan callback invoked while tokens are minted.
External ERC1155 safeTransferFrom/safeBatchTransferFrom calls that can re-enter.
tokenIds: array of NFT ids supplied by the caller.
amounts: array of ERC1155 amounts supplied by the caller.
to: recipient address for mint/redeem/swap output.
amount: number of vault shares to redeem.
specificIds: caller-chosen NFT ids to withdraw.
receiver: caller-supplied flash loan receiver contract.
assetAddr: NFT contract address targeted by the low-level call.
tokenId: NFT id being transferred.
newChildImplementation: candidate beacon implementation address.
count: number of NFTs received and used to size the mint.
totalFee: computed fee amount charged to the user.
redeemedIds: array of token ids returned to the redeemer.
randomIndex: modulo of the weakly-random hash used to pick a token.
data: ABI-encoded calldata built for the low-level NFT call.

edges.reason: vaultFactory is set to msg.sender, making the deployer the trusted factory.
mint delegates to mintTo with msg.sender as recipient.
redeem delegates to redeemTo with msg.sender as recipient.
swap delegates to swapTo with msg.sender as recipient.
mintTo pulls NFTs through receiveNFTs before minting shares.
mintTo charges and distributes mint fees to the recipient.
redeemTo charges and distributes redeem fees from msg.sender.
redeemTo withdraws the requested NFTs to the recipient.
swapTo withdraws NFTs before receiving the swapped-in NFTs.
swapTo receives the caller NFTs after withdrawal.
swapTo charges and distributes swap fees.
feeDistributor address read from the factory is used as the transfer target.
receiveNFTs calls transferERC721 for ERC721 assets.
receiveNFTs calls transferFromERC721 for ERC721 assets.
ERC1155 safeBatchTransferFrom is an external call into an attacker-controlled asset.
withdrawNFTsTo makes external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom calls during state updates.
withdrawNFTsTo uses getRandomTokenIdFromVault when specificIds run out.
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random selection, making it miner-influenceable.
transferERC721 performs the low-level call that moves the NFT out.
transferFromERC721 performs the low-level call that pulls the NFT in.
msg.sender is encoded as the from address in the ERC721 transfer calldata.
msg.sender is the source of NFTs pulled into the vault.
msg.sender is checked against the fee exclusion mapping.
flashLoan mints tokens then invokes receiver.onFlashLoan before burning.
flashLoan checks the lock state before lending.
onlyOwnerIfPaused reads the factory isPaused/isLocked mapping.
onlyOwnerIfPaused compares msg.sender against the owner.
setManager is gated by onlyPrivileged.
setVaultMetadata is gated by onlyPrivileged.
setVaultFeatures is gated by onlyPrivileged.
deployEligibilityStorage is gated by onlyPrivileged.
setFees is gated by onlyPrivileged.
onlyPrivileged compares msg.sender against the mutable manager address.
onlyPrivileged authorizes based on msg.sender.
onlyPrivileged falls back to the owner account.
assignDefaultFeatures hard-codes a dev address comparison against msg.sender.
createVault deploys the vault through deployVault.
deployVault initializes the freshly deployed BeaconProxy vault.
deployVault sets the manager of the new vault.
createVault calls initializeVaultReceivers on the fee distributor.
setVaultFees allows msg.sender equal to the vault address, skipping the owner check.
setVaultFees resolves the vault address from the vaults array.
disableVaultFees allows msg.sender equal to the vault address, skipping the owner check.
setFeeExclusion writes the excludedFromFees mapping.
_implementation reads the beacon then queries childImplementation.
_delegate executes the delegatecall opcode.
_setBeacon delegates init data to the beacon implementation.
_setBeacon validates the implementation address before storing the beacon.
upgradeChildTo is gated by onlyOwner and calls _setChildImplementation.
_setChildImplementation writes _childImplementation after an isContract check.
pause requires msg.sender to be a registered guardian.
setIsGuardian is restricted to the owner.
mintTo reads vaultId when computing fees.
redeemTo reads vaultId when computing fees.
swapTo reads vaultId when computing fees.
vaultFees view forwards vaultId to the factory.
receiveNFTs uses assetAddress for ERC721/ERC1155 transfers.
withdrawNFTsTo uses assetAddress for outgoing transfers.
withdrawNFTsTo decrements quantity1155 and prunes holdings.
receiveNFTs increments quantity1155 and adds holdings.
receiveNFTs registers token ids in the holdings set.
withdrawNFTsTo removes token ids from the holdings set.
receiveNFTs validates eligibility through the eligibility module.
transferFromERC721 checks holdings.contains to prevent duplicate minting.
transferFromERC721 reads the global assetAddress when ownerOf is queried.
transferERC721 assigns the encoded calldata into the local data variable.
transferFromERC721 assigns the encoded calldata into the local data variable.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault stores the modulo result in randomIndex.
mintTo stores receiveNFTs' return value in count and mints base*count.
mintTo multiplies mintFee by count into totalFee (uint64 fee times count).
redeemTo computes totalFee with multiplication and subtraction of fee components.
swapTo computes totalFee with multiplication and subtraction of fee components.
withdrawNFTsTo fills redeemedIds and returns them.
flashLoan mints to and calls back the caller-supplied receiver.
mintTo mints shares to the caller-specified to address.
receiveNFTs iterates the caller-supplied tokenIds array.
receiveNFTs uses the caller-supplied amounts array for ERC1155.
redeemTo validates and consumes the specificIds array.
redeemTo burns base*amount shares from msg.sender.
transferERC721 targets the caller-influenced assetAddr with a raw call.
transferFromERC721 encodes tokenId into the outgoing calldata.
upgradeChildTo passes newChildImplementation to _setChildImplementation.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenIds is only consumed by mintTo/receiveNFTs and carries no independent security meaning.
amounts is an ERC1155-only array consumed by mintTo/receiveNFTs.
to is the mint recipient parameter of mintTo.
amount is the share count burned by redeemTo.
specificIds selects which NFTs redeemTo withdraws.
receiver is the untrusted callback contract invoked by flashLoan.
assetAddr is the call target used by transferERC721's low-level call.
tokenId is encoded into the calldata produced by transferFromERC721.
newChildImplementation is the address stored by _setChildImplementation.
count is a transient accumulator inside mintTo used to size the mint.
totalFee is a transient fee accumulator computed inside mintTo.
redeemedIds is the transient result array produced by withdrawNFTsTo.
randomIndex is the transient index derived by getRandomTokenIdFromVault.
data is the transient encoded calldata built for the low-level NFT call.
